Game Overview
Genre: 2D pixel-art platformer. 
Math Playground
 +1
Levels: Features 32 challenging stages, including special boss battles on levels 26 and 32. 
Core Objective: Collect all hidden coins in each stage to make the exit trophy appear, then reach the trophy to win. 
Mechanics: Move and jump using the WASD or arrow keys, climb ladders, grab umbrellas to glide, or collect wings starting at level 4 to fly. 
Hazards: Avoid falling off platforms, ground spikes, falling ceiling spikes, cannon fire, and teal crawling enemies (though you can jump on some enemies to defeat them or find hidden coins).
